ConnectionStrings.// DefaultConnection: Demo-only LocalDB database shared with the Api demo host: the message store, the demo_transport queue tables and demo.Orders all live here. The E2E MessagingTests fixture overrides it from CLOUDSTRAP_TEST_SQL when set (spec D-3).

Storage.// ConnectionString: Demo-only: the Azurite blob emulator (UseDevelopmentStorage=true = http://127.0.0.1:10000, account devstoreaccount1). The E2E fixture starts Azurite itself, or overrides this from CLOUDSTRAP_TEST_BLOB when set (spec DL-10). A real deployment sets BlobServiceUri instead and authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential.

Worker.// HealthListenAddress: localhost is the documented dev-time override (no firewall prompts on dev machines/CI agents); the shipped default '*' is the all-interfaces container posture.

Messaging.// Transport: SqlServer: this node listens on its workload queue (demo-application-worker) in the shared demo_transport schema; its durability schema is workload-derived (demo_application_worker) — the Api's is demo_application_api, both in the one database (AC-MSG13 visible).
Messaging.// AutoProvision: Not set: on in Development (the E2E fixture runs this host as Development), off elsewhere.
Messaging.// ClaimCheck: Deliberately unset — the defaults are the demo: container 'demo-claimcheck' ({SystemName}-claimcheck) and OffloadThresholdBytes 204800 (200 KiB), the same as the Api's; the account comes from Cloudstrap:Storage above.

Demo.// OutageSentinelPath: Create this file to flip /ready to 503 (the outage drill); delete it to recover. The E2E suite overrides the path per run.
